entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 6613 of 2025

Petitioner :- Raj Singh
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Gaurav Yadav,Keshari Nath Tripathi
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present petition under Article 227 of the Constitution of India has been filed seeking the following reliefs:-
"i) issue a writ, order or direction to set-aside the impugned judgement and order dated 23.05.2025 (Annexure No.1 to this writ petition) passed by Additional District and Sessions Judge, Court No. 18, Meerut in Criminal Revision No. 258 of 2024 (Raj Singh Vs. State of U.P. and others) as well as order dated 27.03.2024 (Annexure No.2 to this writ petition) passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.03,
Meerut in Complaint Case No. 16275 of 2023 (Raj Singh Vs. Sher Singh and others)
under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 379 I.P.C., Police Station- Kankar Kheda,
District-Meerut pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.03, Meerut.

16275 of 2023 (Raj Singh Vs. Sher Singh and others) Under Section 420, 467, 468,
471, 379 I.P.C., Police Station- Kankar Kheda, District- Meerut of the petitioner and pass afresh order by summon to the respondent no.2 to 4 for the offence Under Section 420, 467, 468, 471, 379 I.P.C. in accordance with law."

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner lodged a complaint against respondent Nos. 2 to 4 but the learned trial court has summoned only respondent No. 2, Sher Singh and did not issue summons to respondent Nos. 3 and 4 under Section 379 IPC.

From the perusal of the record, it transpires that in the statement under Section 200 Cr.P.C., given by the complainant, there are allegations only against Sher Singh, respondent No.2 and no such allegations have been made by the complainant against the respondent Nos. 3 and 4.
Accordingly, there is no illegality in the order impugned and the writ petition is dismissed.
Order Date :- 9.7.2025 Aditya Tripathi  Raj Singh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151211565/
